decisions.reason: Because it was launched as a flagship tied to the firm's stated sustainability direction, management is still inclined to defend that visible commitment and interpret its weak recent visibility as not yet enough to justify withdrawal.

As a multi-model crate line that fits the firm's core reusable-packaging business, it is likely to be retained a bit longer because prior development effort can still be justified and poor traction can be blamed on temporary market factors.

Although the firm invested in and publicly presented this line, two years without visible support make the temporary-cause story less credible and its fit is easier to sacrifice in favor of stronger core products and new development.

Despite earlier stand-alone promotion and clear adjacency to the pallet business, its prolonged lack of visibility makes it easier for management to prune this narrower offer and reallocate resources while still preserving the broader logistics-value narrative.
